stage: initial diagnostic and matched learning pilot; source assumptions inspected before outputs
plant_exposure: already consumed synthetic plant/circuit/target tuples; no untouched validation claim
local_plasticity: unchanged pinned Gong source; no-clock circuit retrained from original untutored state for 35 literal renditions with HVC identically zero
readout: uniform mean excitatory activity over complete 1300-ms probe, same for all circuit modes; old 120-ms-window score separately reproduced
onset_reset: detect first nonzero auditory sample using fixed threshold1e-8; reset retained 15-HVC template to its known first onset; target-blind origin detection, still supplied relative template
actor: 4 normalized shape coordinates and one of six fixed order permutations; fixed known unit gain; no duration-control axis in this initial actor
query_count: 1 + 16 * rounds: eight coordinate proposals, five other order permutations, three broad target-blind proposals each round
oracle_gate: at least80% true feature-sequence error removed; if it fails, extend/revise actor equally before attributing a teacher failure
seed: 80000+plant_id; same random proposal draws in all arms
gold_score: mean squared error between canonical six sensory patterns, with actor-selected order, and tutor patterns; global onset is irrelevant by construction
information: circuit actors receive only scalar feedback; true losses are computed after search, except privileged oracle; feedback-query slots are counted even for exact memoization
important_limit: order recovery within this frozen six-permutation family is narrower than learning new temporal correspondence; no physical vocal or biological mechanism claim
